description: A collector's vouch for another collector's trustworthiness. Mirrored from the SwapPulse Vouch entity so the trust graph is portable and verifiable across PDSs and SwapPulse instances.

main.description: A single vouch from one collector endorsing another.

vouchedDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the endorsed collector

voucherDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the voucher (embedded so the record is self-describing on the network)

context.description: Brief explanation of why this vouch is given

items.description: at:// URI of a completed trade record supporting this vouch

revokedAt.description: When the vouch was revoked (null if active)
